##### Project general facts

Anta Residence is a premium residential complex that brings together modern luxury, vibrant lifestyle, and world-class hospitality in the heart of Canggu. Located on the lively Batu Bolong street, the development offers elegant apartments designed for comfort, style, and long-term investment appeal in one of Bali’s most desirable coastal destinations. Just minutes from the beautiful shores of the Indian Ocean, the project places residents close to renowned beaches and surf spots while surrounding them with the energy of Canggu’s trendy cafés, restaurants, and lifestyle venues. The project offers the comfort of resort-style living combined with professional hospitality standards.

The development features an impressive selection of amenities designed to elevate everyday living and create a true five-star experience. Residents can relax at the tropical infinity swimming pool with breathtaking ocean views or enjoy the unique rooftop jungle park that creates a tranquil oasis above the city. Social and lifestyle spaces include a branded restaurant, stylish coffee shop, and a rooftop event hall perfect for gatherings and memorable occasions. Wellness and recreation are equally emphasized through a modern smart gym, beauty and SPA salon, dedicated children’s area with babysitting services, and even a surf school for those eager to embrace Bali’s famous waves. Additional conveniences such as co-working spaces and private golf cart transportation ensure a seamless and enjoyable lifestyle.

Each residence is designed with attention to elegance, practicality, and contemporary style. The apartments come fully furnished, allowing residents to move in immediately and enjoy a refined living environment. Interiors feature carefully selected materials and modern finishes that reflect a sophisticated tropical aesthetic while maintaining comfort and functionality. The fully equipped kitchens are designed with quality appliances and practical layouts, making everyday living effortless and enjoyable. Thoughtful architectural planning, landscaping, and façade design further enhance the project’s distinctive character, creating homes that feel both luxurious and welcoming.

##### Parking 
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Canggu is one of Bali’s most dynamic and desirable coastal destinations, known for its relaxed atmosphere, creative culture, and vibrant international community. Located along the island’s southwest coast, the area has become a favorite place for surfers, digital nomads, entrepreneurs, and travelers seeking a balanced lifestyle that blends work, leisure, and nature. Its unique charm lies in the seamless combination of beachfront living, modern lifestyle venues, and authentic Balinese culture.

The beaches of Canggu are among the area’s greatest attractions, offering dramatic black-sand shorelines and world-class surf breaks that draw surfers from around the globe. Visitors and residents alike enjoy spectacular sunsets over the Indian Ocean, vibrant beach clubs, and a lively coastal culture centered around surfing, relaxation, and outdoor living. Beyond the shoreline, the area is filled with stylish cafés, international restaurants, boutique stores, and wellness studios that give the district its signature bohemian and artistic atmosphere.

Beyond the modern lifestyle offerings, the surrounding landscape reveals the timeless beauty of Bali. Lush rice fields and traditional villages create a serene natural setting that contrasts beautifully with the energy of the coastal streets. This balance of cultural heritage, scenic nature, and contemporary lifestyle infrastructure makes the area one of the most attractive locations on the island for both long-term living and property investment.
